visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Tagged Union Instead of Parallel Variables
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A type flag and two separate variables describe one value that is either an int or a double. Use a struct with an enum tag and a union, and a function that prints it. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A tagged union stores exactly one of the alternatives plus a tag saying which one is valid. The printing logic is written once in show instead of being copied for every value.
